selection: Require one strength/allocation combination to pass every price source, flow mode, history, population and execution scenario at 10% proceeds cost plus fees, with at least eight trades and positive returns after two-best-token and best-day removal. At each drawdown ceiling maximize minimum return, then higher drawdown bound, then lower strength and policy ID. Exhaustive pair checks are required before treating a selection as passing.
scope: Retrospective sizing sensitivity on the existing examined dates. Factors derive only from the earlier saved causal features. It can propose a later paper candidate but is not independent validation. Existing prospective rules remain unchanged.
